derivation: probably from the base of G2767 (κεράννυμι) (through the idea of mixing clay and water);
def: earthenware, i.e. a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning)

occurrences.text: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
